head.name: allowance
head.note: 0.10% a day: the box fills to at most seven days, is drawn, the rate is lowered at once and raised after a time unit, a lapse stops it

head.name: allowance-ceiling
head.note: 0.20% a day, nobody draws: the box holds at most seven days (1.40% of pot and box)

head.name: lapse
head.note: a 60-day lapse pays nothing for the idle time; the box holds only what accrued inside the window

head.name: revenue-merge
head.note: two payments merge into one stream that is fully in the pot by its end

head.name: team-surplus
head.note: Team Shares are paid only from the pot above paid-in: nothing at or under it

head.name: revenue-before-first
head.note: outside money 20,000 arrives before any backer: the first backer pays for a slice of it in the price and is not credited it as paid-in

head.name: teams-leftover
head.note: after the last backer leaves, the Team's slice of the surplus stays; the next first backer pays for a slice of it

head.name: forfeit
head.note: an own exit announces the unvested part to burn: joiners are priced as if it were gone; it burns a time unit later

head.name: task-rejected
head.note: a rejected task sends the whole 5,000 back: the note is paid in full and the stayers lose nothing

head.name: task-paid-in-full
head.note: a task paid in full voids the notes: the leaver keeps the cash, the stayers bear the payment

head.name: task-runs-out

head.name: task-runs-out-after-allowance

head.name: task-lapses

head.name: task-wind-down
head.note: a wind-down returns every open task: the notes keep their face and are claimed afterwards

head.name: task-team-take-out
head.note: a Team Share holder takes out while money is set aside: cash by the Team formula and a note for the rest

head.name: task-join-during-lock
head.note: a joiner pays the money set aside at face; the task is returned and nobody gains or loses by timing

head.name: task-cap-rolling-28-days
head.note: taken 10% in 28 days, then a refused take, then the take at exactly 28 days after

head.name: task-cap-given-back
head.note: a rejected or expired take gives its share of the cap back; a paid take keeps it
